name: Card Printing
definition: A single printing of a Magic: The Gathering card in a specific set. Each row of tab01 is one printing and carries its own attributes such as name, artist, border colour, power and flags.
scope: Card-level analysis over the card table.

name: Card Name
definition: The printed name of a card printing. The same card name can occur in several sets and printings, so a name identifies a card concept while a row identifies one printing.
scope: Card identification and filtering by title.

name: Artist
definition: Name of the illustrator credited on a card printing.
scope: Artist-based grouping and filtering over card printings.

name: Border Colour
definition: The colour of the border of a card printing: black, white, gold, silver or borderless.
scope: Card appearance analysis; applies to every card printing.

name: Card Colour
definition: The mana colour identity expressed by the card's colour indicator (the colours the card actually is), encoded as single letters W, U, B, R, G and combined with commas for multicolour cards.
scope: Colour-based filtering of card printings. Distinct from colour identity, which also includes colours of mana symbols in rules text.

name: Frame Version
definition: The frame version (frame style era) of a card printing, expressed as the year the frame design was introduced, or 'future' for future-shifted frames.
scope: Card appearance analysis and grouping by frame style.

name: Power
definition: The power characteristic printed on a creature card, stored as text because it can be numeric, starred, or absent.
scope: Creature statistics; applies only to cards that have a power value.

name: Card Type
definition: The primary card type(s) of a card, such as Artifact, Creature, Enchantment, Instant, Land, Planeswalker or Sorcery.
scope: Type-based filtering; a card may carry more than one primary type.

name: Card Type Line
definition: The complete type line of a card, combining supertypes, primary types and subtypes, as printed in the current wording.
scope: Full textual type information for a printing.

name: Original Type Line
definition: The type line as originally printed, using the older hyphenated wording (for example 'Creature - Human Cleric') instead of the modern em-dash wording.
scope: Historic printed wording of the type line; values differ from the current type line only in punctuation and wording.

name: Card Subtype
definition: The subtype(s) of a card, such as Human, Cleric, Aura or Forest, stored as a comma-separated list.
scope: Subtype-based filtering and listing.

name: Card Supertype
definition: The supertype(s) of a card: Legendary, Basic, Snow, World, Host or Ongoing. Absent when the card has no supertype.
scope: Supertype-based filtering and listing.

name: Card Text
definition: The current rules text (oracle text) of a card, including keyword reminders and ability wording.
scope: Full-text search over card abilities.

name: Original Card Text
definition: The rules text as originally printed for that edition, which may use older terminology than the current oracle wording. Absent for textless printings.
scope: Historic printed wording; not equivalent to the current rules text.

name: Card Set
definition: A card set (expansion, core set, promo set, commander set and so on) that groups card printings and owns set-level metadata such as release date, base set size and availability restrictions.
scope: Set-level analysis and joins between card printings and set metadata.

name: Set Name
definition: The full English name of a card set, for example 'Eighth Edition', 'Coldsnap' or 'Hour of Devastation'.
scope: Set identification and filtering by set name.

name: Set Code
definition: The short alphanumeric code that identifies a card set, such as 10E, CSP or HOU. Card printings carry the code of the set they were printed in, and the set table carries the same code as its identifier.
scope: Reliable join key between card printings and set metadata.

name: Base Set Size
definition: The number of cards in the base set of a set, excluding bonus and special cards. This is the set's 'base set number'.
scope: Set size analysis; distinct from the total set size.
aliases: number of cards in the set

name: Foreign-Only Set
definition: Flag indicating that a card set was released only outside the United States.
scope: Set availability analysis.
aliases: only available outside the United States

name: Promotional Printing
definition: Flag indicating that a card printing is a promotional printing rather than a regular set printing.
scope: Card printing classification.

name: Story Spotlight Card
definition: Flag indicating that a card is a Story Spotlight card, a card that advances the set's narrative.
scope: Card printing classification.

name: Textless Printing
definition: Flag indicating that a card printing has no text box and shows only artwork, even though its rules text may still be recorded in the text columns.
scope: Card printing appearance classification.

name: Foil Version Availability
definition: Presence of a commercial foil product identifier for the card printing. The column holds an external market product id whose presence indicates that the set released a foil version of the card.
scope: Foil availability analysis; only the presence or absence of the identifier is meaningful.

name: Non-Foil Version Availability
definition: Presence of a commercial non-foil product identifier for the card printing. The column holds an external market product id whose presence indicates that the set released a non-foil version of the card.
scope: Non-foil availability analysis; only the presence or absence of the identifier is meaningful.

name: Language
definition: A language in which a card or set has localised data. Observed values include Japanese, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Russian and Korean.
scope: Language filtering for card and set translations.

name: Card Translation
definition: A foreign-language data record for a card printing. One row exists per card and language and holds the localised name, rules text, type and flavour text.
scope: Existence of a card in a given language.

name: Translated Card Name
definition: The name of a card in a specific non-English language.
scope: Localised card naming; only populated on translation records.

name: Set Translation
definition: A localisation record for a card set. One row exists per set and language.
scope: Existence and content of set-name translations.

name: Translated Set Name
definition: The name of a card set in a specific language. The value is absent when the localisation record carries no translated name.
scope: Localised set naming; 'has a translation' means this value is present.
aliases: translation of the name of the set

name: Ruling
definition: An official ruling record about a card, consisting of ruling text and the date the ruling was issued.
scope: Ruling counts and ruling text for a card.

name: Ruling Text
definition: The explanatory text of an official ruling.
scope: Full-text search over rulings.

name: Play Format
definition: A tournament or casual play format, such as commander, modern, legacy, vintage, standard or pioneer.
scope: Format-based legality analysis.

name: Legality Status
definition: The status of a card in a play format: Legal, Banned or Restricted.
scope: Interpretation of legality records.

name: Format Legality Record
definition: One record stating the legality status of one card in one play format.
scope: Per-card per-format legality.

name: Card Count
definition: The number of card printings selected by a set of conditions.
scope: Counting questions over any population of card printings.

name: Card Share (Percentage)
definition: A percentage metric expressing the number of card printings that satisfy a condition divided by the number of card printings in the reference population, multiplied by one hundred.
scope: Percentage questions about card printings; the denominator is the card population in scope, not the filtered subset.
